public.title: Text Search II
public.description: input {text,terms}; text and terms are lowercase ASCII, every term is nonempty. Find all occurrences of every term, including overlapping matches. Return sorted maximal half-open [start,end] highlight ranges by merging overlapping or touching matches. Duplicate terms do not duplicate output. Empty terms array yields []. Text length at most 100, at most 8 terms of length at most 20. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, fixtures and reference solutions, 2026. Covers a common JavaScript practice topic; no third-party exercise text or implementation copied.

explanation: Collect candidate matches, sort and merge their union. O(terms times text length times term length plus matches log matches) time and O(matches) space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
